R245.note: Clean parameterization with named SqlParameters; preserves tenant scoping, row-count return, and invalid dates still fail (via conversion error) rather than broadening the predicate.

R246.note: Adds 'can:update,order' to the purge route, matching the pattern already used for update/cancel; no dedicated purge ability exists in the case so reusing update is a reasonable, disclosed choice.

R247.note: Removes the shell call entirely (closes injection) but silently redefines 'reachable' from ICMP ping to a TCP:80 connect, which will report unreachable for hosts that answer ping but don't listen on port 80; disclosed only as a 'reasonable proxy'.

R248.note: JexlSandbox(false)+newInstance(false) is a solid primary fix, but the added allowlist regex omits +, *, /, % so legitimate arithmetic filter expressions (e.g. amount * 1.1 > total) would be rejected, not called out in the write-up.

R249.note: Adds the same @PreAuthorize used on deleteInvoice to the public entry point, correctly closing the self-invocation proxy-bypass with no other behavior change.

R250.note: basename()+realpath() containment check matches the file's own stated flat-filename convention; headers/content unaffected for legitimate requests.

R251.note: Sandboxed JEXL closes the sink, but swapping the persisted rule language from JavaScript to JEXL silently breaks any already-saved rule using JS syntax (===, typeof, statements) since JexlExpression only parses a single JEXL expression -- write-up incorrectly claims full behavior preservation.

R252.note: Correct GET->POST + [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] fix, but it breaks the existing GET-based 'Yes, delete my account' link, which the write-up openly states must become a POST form.

R253.note: resolve(strict=True)+is_relative_to correctly follows symlinks and fixes the string-prefix containment bug; fails closed on missing/escaping paths per the contract.

R254.note: Verified with Node+sequelize+sqlite in a scratch dir: ':startDate' is replacement syntax, not bind syntax (bind needs '$startDate'); combined with the bind option it throws SQLITE_RANGE on every call, so the fixed endpoint never returns a report despite the write-up's claim that behavior is preserved.

R255.note: Standard divide-before-multiply overflow check plus null-input guard; frees the outer batch on every error path so there's no leak, matching the contract.

R256.note: filepath.Rel + strings.HasPrefix(rel, "..") blocks real traversal, but the bare prefix check also matches legitimate filenames that literally start with '..' (should require exact '..' or '..'+separator), a narrow but real false-rejection.

R257.note: Replaces extension-based probeContentType with Tika magic-byte detection, closing the vector with no other observable change; names the tika-core dependency.

R258.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) overrides any client-supplied owner value per DRF's kwargs-over-validated_data semantics, closing both the missing-assignment and mass-assignment angles for create.

R259.note: subtle.ConstantTimeCompare enforces exact-match semantics matching the stated contract, with the empty-token short-circuit preserved.
